notes.title: Major Content Update! [Update-update: 17/4]
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! Let's get right into it!

[list]
[*] [b]New content![/b] That's right! If you've played the game, you may recall a certain door you couldn't enter close to the end of the game, one shining with golden light. For this and that reasons, it was closed to you, but now you can explore it at your heart's content! New secrets and conversations await you!
[*] [b]Achievements...Less borked?![/b] Well, Steam achievements were generally okay, but the in-game achievement tracker was notoriously finicky. It should be more reliable now.
[*] [b]Bug and polish fixes![/b] The Library softlock on Owen's route should be thoroughly squashed, and we took care of some weird sprite behaviour in cutscenes. You might still notice some odd things here or there, but the experience should be a lot smoother!
[/list]

We hope both those of you who've completed the game and those playing for the first time will enjoy the extra content! Incidentally, if you follow our Twitter at [url=https://twitter.com/SpiderLilyGames]@SpiderLilyGames[/url], you'll be seeing a lot more content for both Retrace and our next projects. Thank you for continuing to support us!

[b]17/4/21 ANOTHER UPDATE[/b]
There was a bug in the update but I fixed it. Sorry!

notes.title: Cursed Brooches and Console Releases
notes.content:
It's been a while, everyone! I hope you're all doing okay. Let's get right into it...

[list]
[*] There were a few cases of the Miowen end not triggering because the Brooch item was entering the inventory before the cutscene where Freya receives it. I'm going to be honest, I have scoured the code and I cannot find any reason why this would be happening, but there is now a safety check in place that should take any illicitly-obtained brooches from your inventory, should you somehow acquire one. If you still encounter this bug, I would be greatly, greatly appreciative if you would go into your C:/Users/[User]/AppData/retrace folder, grab the retrace.save file and send it to contact@spiderlilystudios.com. Seriously, this is keeping me up at night. Game's haunted.
[*] The "Gore" setting button now changes colour as well as position to indicate whether it's toggled.
[*] Onto more exciting news, Retrace will be available on Xbox 1, PS4 and Nintendo Switch from Feburary 24th! And as a result, I'm about to put through a price change for Steam as well. It's always an awkward thing to talk about, but basically, I learned a lot about selling games in the past year and I think this is the right thing to do.
[/list]

As always, I really appreciate everyone's support, and I hope you'll continue to enjoy Retrace and look forward to Schrodinger's Catgirl!

notes.title: Update: Fast Forwarding! (and some bugfixes)
notes.content:
Update time! This is a really exciting one...!

[h2]Fast forwarding is here![/h2]
Just press the "F" key and you'll toggle fast forward mode on and off! It'll skip through dialogue, pausing at choices!
I really thought coding this would be beyond my skills, but it seems I improved even in the time since release. I'm really glad I could bring you all this feature, because I know it's something a lot of people have asked for.
If you run into any problems please let me know!

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The infinite knife has been defeated!
[*] No longer softlocked if you retrace to Owen's starting room after beating the puzzle.
[*] A door in Claire's route that wasn't working, is working again
[*] Gore button now has a slight red filter to better indicate when it's set to "true".
[*] A certain CG that didn't have its own window, now has one!

There's a known bug that happens in the Lucen path, to do with being sent to get something that you already have. I'm still tracking that one down, so if you encounter it, could you send a copy of your save to contact [at] spiderlilystudios [dot] com, please?
[/list]

By the way, if you enjoyed the game, I'd really appreciate it if you took the time to leave a review. I'm still working to make Retrace the best experience it can be!

notes.title: Patch Notes: 1.1
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! There's even more of you since we last spoke! I hope everyone's enjoying Retrace!

Today, I'm bringing you ... version 1.1! Now with a shiny new feature!

[h1]In-game Achievements are here![/h1]

Find them in your Diary, on the last tab.
[list]
[*] Click on any that you've successfully obtained to see their name and description!
[*] The first time you open it, the game will attempt to update any that you've already unlocked on your current save. However, due to the way the code was originally written, the Gold and White ends, as well as the achievements "Until I Return" and "Retraced Days", weren't saved internally. "Until I Return" can be triggered if you have a save that's currently in the second half of the game, but the other three will need to be completed again. I'm really sorry about that!
[*] There's also now a counter underneath the "Merry Bad END" achievement tracking the number of bad ends you've found! This should be compatible with old saves automatically. Do your best!
[/list]

Incidentally, I uploaded the Concept Art Booklet! It contains not only the original concept art, but a bunch of extra character information and design notes from yours truly. You can purchase it for $2 at our Ko-fi store [url=https://ko-fi.com/spiderlilystudios/shop]here[/url]. We also have stickers, if you like those! They're cute chibis of Freya, Lucas and Claire. (I want to do the other characters, but I need to sell all these ones first. You  know how it is.)

Thank you again, everyone! If you enjoyed the game, it would mean a lot to me if you left a review. Spider Lily Studios is only a micro-studio, but I want to keep making meaningful and thoughtful games, without crunch. Your kind words will help us prove to publishers that there's an audience for this type of game, as well as helping more people find Retrace on the store!

As for the future, I'm currently working on Hope Sustains, which is a farm sim with a botanical art aesthetic, Mendelian genetics system, and a focus on restoring the land and building a community through sustainable farming! ... It's a bit different to this game. But don't worry, because there's also a Secret Project that's much more Retrace-like in plot. It's a bit early to talk about the details, but I'll keep you posted as we move forward!

notes.title: Post-release update (and bug fixes)
notes.content:
Okay, first, let's go through the fixes!
[list]
[*] The achievement "Merry Bad End" is no longer bugged, but does now require one extra end that was missing (eight in total now).
[*] Various instances where the wrong text would play have been fixed
[*] The items for the Magpie puzzle no longer respawn
[*] Lucas no longer follows you during the dungeon section of his route, preventing him from getting stuck. We're still working on preventing other NPCs (*cough* Mia *cough*) from getting stuck, so please accept our apologies while we do!
[/list]

With a team as small as ours, it was pretty much inevitable that there would be bugs we couldn't find between us on release, but we still deeply regret that you all had to see them, so from the bottom of our hearts, we apologise, and thank you for your patience and reports!

We didn't end up writing a release devlog, mostly because Els got stressed out and busy with the actual business of releasing the game. There are so many buttons to press and boxes to check! But, the response has been really great...! Every heartfelt review has filled us with warmth and a determination to do even better! We'll keep providing fixes as much as we can. We're also going to upload a spoiler-free guide, since a few people have requested it. Els will go write that now, actually...

For more frequent updates, the best place to go is [url=https://twitter.com/retracegame]our Twitter page[/url]. Otherwise, until next time, everyone!

notes.title: Update: Oct-Nov
notes.content:
This is going to be a short update because we're all super busy with the final bug fixing push. You might think, "how many bugs can there possibly be?", but with a game that has so many choices and possibilities, we really have to test everything thoroughly before we can show it to you. So please cheer us on!

Here's the approximate completion amount for the game!
Script (English): 100%
Script (Simplified Chinese): 100%
Art: 99.5% (one CG remaining)
Content implementation: 100%
Bug testing: About 90%. 

That last one's hard to quantify, but to put it simply, if we can get past this one complicated section, everything else will be smooth sailing.

Also, we visited EGX last month, and since then, we've reached 1000 wishlists! Thank you so much! We won't let you down, everyone! 

Don't forget to follow our Twitter as well! You'll be able to see even more updates, and maybe even a special giveaway...?!

Thank you again for your patience and kindness. Please look forward to a wonderful game!

notes.title: Demo update: Simplified Chinese support added!
notes.content:
我们很高兴能够宣布：Retrace时间回溯将在发售时支持简体中文！当然了，现在您也可游玩简体中文版本的试玩版！十分感谢中国玩家的耐心等待。希望你们能够尽情享受该游戏的乐趣！

We're pleased to announce that Retrace will be available in Simplified Chinese at launch, and you can now play the demo in Simplified Chinese as well! To our Chinese fans, thank you for your patience and we hope you enjoy!

This update also includes a lot of fixes. We had to work hard, but the variable tracker (turns out in a game where you're constantly rewinding time, there are a lot of variables to track!) is a lot more robust and reliable now, so please enjoy this lovely and elegant death game even more~

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.5.1 is here!
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who's played so far! Because of your helpful feedback, we've made some quick changes to make the demo even better!

[list]
[*] Added SFX for picking up objects and making choices!
[*] Made certain game aspects like saving clearer
[*] Added 'return to title' to the Menu
[*] Added option to retrace to the Library after seeing its cutscene
[/list]

Please continue to share and wishlist, and thank you again! As we keep finalising assets, the demo will continue to get better and better, so watch this space...!

notes.title: Retrace Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
[h1]It's here...?! The Retrace Demo is out now on Steam and Itch!
[/h1]

We've been working really hard to bring you this taster of what's to come in the full game! Here's what you need to know:

[list]
[*] You'll be able to play through [b]Lucas' Path. [/b]
[*] Retrace is not like a normal visual novel -- reaching an END is [b]not the full experience[/b]! That will become clear when you play it, but rest assured, you [b]won't be spoiling the full experience[/b] just by playing the demo!
[*] Will you be able to bring your save over? ... Maybe. But there will be some [b]extra content [/b]in Lucas' path on the full game, so you'll probably want to replay it anyway!
[/list]

notes.title: Devlog: Resurfacing from the Development Ocean
notes.content:
Hello, friends! Goodness, it's been quite some time, hm? Or if this is your first time reading one of our devlogs, hello and nice to meet you! My name is Els, I'm the lead developer on Retrace, and I've been just a taaaaad busy making the game and left devlogging to one side. But no longer! Let's see where we're at, shall we?

[h1]
[b]New Trailer[/b][/h1]

First off, check out our sweet new trailer, courtesy of @GaryJKings! Hopefully it'll give you a good taste of what's to come.

[h1][b]EGX, Norwich and Beyond ...?[/b][/h1]

Thanks to everyone who visited us at EGX Rezzed! It was so great to meet you all! We received some great feedback and really kind comments, and we're even more pumped up to bring you an amazing game! We'll be at Norwich Games Fest on the 31st of May and 1st of June, and we really hope to see some more people there! After that, will we be at more events...!? Only time will tell, so watch this space!!)

[h1]
[b]Development!
[/b][/h1]

This is the important part, right? Here's where we're at in terms of completeness.

[list]
[*] The Script: 99% finished.
[*] The Systems: 90% complete.
[*] Content Implementation: About 55% complete (thank you, Juju!)
[*] Music: 100% complete (thank you, Trass/HarmonicBlend!)
[*]  UI: 100% Complete (thank you, Selina/carmiico!)
[*] Art:
[list][*]Walksprites 100% complete
[*] Talksprites: 100% complete; redoing them in HD is something of a stretch goal, mostly because Domi is a perfectionist
[*] BGSs: About 80% done
[*] CGs: 0% done; they're our last goal before finalising all the art assets
[/list]
[/list]
And that about covers it! In other words, the part that we're waiting on is content implementation. Huh? That's my job...? Well, that's true. I'm working hard!


If you're curious what content implementation means, it's essentially taking the written scripts, plugging them into Juju's wonderful dialogue engine, hooking them up to in-game events, and also putting together cutscenes and wrangling variables. It can be difficult and fiddly work, but I'm 'over the hump'!

I'm going to do my best to write more longform posts here, but if you'd like more frequent and shorter updates, please check us out on Instagram and Twitter at @retracegame. We've also got a Steam page where you can wishlist Retrace! We really appreciate your support!

Until next time, everyone~

Els

Retrace
Overcome death. Save your friends. Solve the mystery.
